ingestion_flows.source_description: TC-CDC-004: Auto Loader employee dimension ingestion with cdc_load_strategy SCD2 -- verifies a department transfer (E101: D1 -> D2) opens a new history version (__START_AT/__END_AT) instead of overwriting the row, that an unrelated column bump alone (E102/E103's updated_at advancing with dept_id unchanged) does NOT open a new version because columns_to_check scopes tracking to dept_id only, and that the framework's auto-generated dim_employee_scd2_current companion view (cdc/scd.py::register_scd2_reporting_view) reports only the active D2 row for E101
